critical_code_review_comments: kokoro_tts() cleans markdown/emoji BEFORE returning None-check on empty; if input is only emoji/markdown it returns None → caller falls back to OpenAI cloud. Behaviour acceptable but silently switches engine (not surfaced to user). Not blocking.

viola-wake/transcribe accepts audio_base64 without a hard upper cap check before base64.b64decode (b64 payload can exceed 20MB even though decoded raw is capped at 15MB). Minor DoS concern; not blocking.
